countries.name: Canada
countries.bouldeer_cities: Toronto 8 (incl. Downsview, Etobicoke, Koreatown), Vancouver 3, North Vancouver 1, Montreal 6 (incl. Saint-Michel, Pointe-Saint-Charles), Calgary 3, Ottawa/Kanata 1, Mississauga 2, Kitchener 1, Port Alberni 1. Zero in Alberta outside Calgary, zero in Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Atlantic Canada, Quebec outside Montreal.

independent_total.basis: Gripped/CBJ counted 136 climbing gyms in Canada in early 2022 (all climbing gyms incl. rope-only, facility level); later CBJ yearly reports add roughly 7 (2024) and 11 (2025) openings, so about 150-160 now before subtracting rope-only/closed ones and before adding extra branches. A scraped directory (rentechdigital, low quality) claims 183 'rock climbing gyms' as of April 2026 (QC 57, ON 49, BC 40). Provincial cross-checks: Mountain Project lists 48 Ontario and 46 BC entries (includes universities/rec centres and some closed); indoorclimbing.com lists 34 Ontario gyms (29 with bouldering); Climbing Canada's page lists BC 27, QC 25, ON 23, AB 4, MB 3, NB 3, SK 2, NS 2, NL 1 (dated, incomplete); FQME/Geo Plein Air say 36 bouldering centres in Quebec. Estimate of public facilities with a bouldering offer, counting chain branches separately: 130-170.

indicative_gap.basis: Independent total 130-170 minus Bouldeer 23 = 107-147; cross-check (1 - 0.26) x 130-170 = 96-126. Full-list cross-matches are even lower than the sample: Bouldeer matches only about 8 of 48 Mountain Project Ontario entries (0.17) and 5 of 46 BC entries (0.11). Quoted gap 100-145.

Seven Bays (3 gyms in Halifax area, Bouldeer 0)

Gneiss Climbing (2 gyms), BoulderHouse (2 gyms), Gravity Climbing (2 gyms), Rose Bloc (2 gyms), Climb Base5 Coquitlam, Grand River Rocks Waterloo, Basecamp Queen St, Bloc Shop (FQME lists 3 sites, Bouldeer 1), Coyote Rock Gym, Junction + J2 London
countries.difficulty_reason: Large gap but well documented: chain location pages, FQME (Quebec) member list, provincial directories and many own-site pages in English or French. Needs per-province sections (ON, QC, BC, AB, rest) and about 100+ gyms, but few social-only gyms.
countries.notes: Largest gap of the four countries by volume. Bouldeer coverage looks like a Toronto/Vancouver/Montreal/Calgary core only. Sample is 23 (not fully independent: the 6 found gyms were picked among well-known ones; the full-list cross-matches 0.11-0.17 are the better ratio). Gym counts from Gripped are 2022 and facility-level; the 183 figure is an unverified scrape. Rope-only walls (e.g. Reach Aurora, ARC Sudbury, Rock and Rope Peterborough) are excluded from the estimate. Project Climbing Centre bouldering offer not confirmed on its own page, so not used in the sample.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.bouldeer_cities: Ciudad de Mexico 8 (incl. Interlomas 1), Monterrey 4, Toluca 2, Zapopan 2

independent_total.basis: CBJ (Feb 2023) said 29 gyms known in Mexico; CBJ later reports 2 openings in 2025. Directories: Mountain Project 27 entries, indoorclimbing.com 38 (26 cities, includes non-public/campus walls), Redpoint app 37, boulderinglist 20. De-duplicated union of these lists plus gyms found by search (Summit Escalada, Ameyalli, Moonrock, Boulder Base, Arena Boulder, Santuario Boulder, Elevity) comes to roughly 45-55 gyms with a bouldering offer. Range widened to 40-60.

indicative_gap.basis: Independent total 40-60 minus Bouldeer 16 = 24-44; cross-check (1 - 0.32) x 40-60 = 27-41. Mountain Project list cross-match gives 9 of 24 on Bouldeer (0.38). Quoted gap 25-45.

missing_chains: Adamanta (Bouldeer has Escandon, Santa Fe, Sierra; missing Satelite and Puebla)
countries.difficulty_reason: Small total (about 50), but Spanish-language, several gyms known mainly through Instagram/Facebook, and a few Bouldeer-style big-name gyms already covered. Research would be a single national section; avoid counting social-only walls.
countries.notes: Bouldeer covers CDMX and Monterrey reasonably well (CDMX has about 8 of roughly 14 known gyms) but misses Guadalajara, Puebla and most secondary cities. Directory counts overstate public bouldering because they include campus walls (ITESM Hidalgo etc.), outdoor walls and rope-only towers (The Wall, The Muro); those were excluded from the estimate. A few smaller names (Mantis Climbing, 360 Climbing, Punto Muerto, Ameyalli) were seen only in directories or blog posts and are not in the sample.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.bouldeer_cities: Sao Paulo 6, Belo Horizonte 5, Curitiba 3, Rio de Janeiro 1

independent_total.basis: Brazilian Climbing Confederation (CBE) mapped 68 indoor climbing gyms in a list published by Go Outside on 2024-12-20 (all climbing gyms; boulder is offered at most, but some are rope-focused; branches counted separately). ABEE reported about 70 accredited gyms (nearly half opened in the last 5 years). The CBE list omits some known boulder gyms (Limite Vertical Rio, Escalada Indoor Icaraí Niteroi, Blocs Florianopolis, Geoboulderusp Sao Paulo, Soul Climb BH, Cafe com Magnesio Fortaleza, ClimbingWall Porto Alegre), so true count is probably 65-90. Smaller directories: TopClimbing 62, Bora Escalar 38, indoorclimbing.com 18, boulderinglist 19, Redpoint 11.

indicative_gap.basis: Independent total 65-90 minus Bouldeer 15 = 50-75; cross-check (1 - 0.33) x 68 = 46. Direct match of the full CBE 68-gym list: Bouldeer has about 14 of them (0.21), which gives 54 missing. Quoted gap 50-75.

missing_chains: No large chain missing: Fabrica (3 of 3) and Casa de Pedra (2 of 2) are in Bouldeer. Missing multi-site names: UBT Brasilia (Bouldeer has only UBT Curitiba), Granito Niteroi, Jurape/Fels Joinville
countries.difficulty_reason: A federation list (CBE, 68 gyms with city) exists and covers most gyms, Portuguese pages are readable, and most entries have own sites. Difficulty comes from spread over many small interior cities and several social-only or schools; also needs a bouldering-offer check per gym since the CBE list is all indoor gyms. Likely two sections (Sao Paulo state + rest).
countries.notes: Bouldeer is concentrated in Sao Paulo city, Belo Horizonte and Curitiba and has one Rio gym. Sample of 18 includes 6 already on Bouldeer; the full CBE cross-match (0.21) is the more reliable ratio. Campo Base Curitiba (on CBE list) appears marked closed on Foursquare, so it was not used. Not checked: whether Bouldeer's Summit, ROKAZ Academy and Via Aventura entries are current; they were not investigated.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.bouldeer_cities: CABA 5 (incl. Balvanera, Almagro), Buenos Aires province (Acassuso, Monte Grande, Tandil, Burzaco, Avellaneda, Bella Vista, Tres Arroyos, Berazategui, La Plata, Florida/Vicente Lopez), Cordoba 2, Rosario 1, Parana 1, San Rafael 1, Plaza Huincul 1. Nothing in Mendoza city, Tucuman, Bariloche, Mar del Plata, Santa Fe city, Salta or Patagonia (apart from Plaza Huincul).

independent_total.basis: No federation or press figure found (FASA's club list is mountaineering/ski clubs). Directories: indoorclimbing.com 38 (28 listed), climbing-gyms.com 19, boulderinglist 20, Mountain Project 13, Redpoint 9. The directories that list most gyms are the same ones Bouldeer appears to have used, so the union is the best estimate: Bouldeer's 20 plus about 25 further gyms with a bouldering offer found across directories and search (Rustik, Realization, Bucarelli, Avista, Punto Cumbre, Campus, El Muro Mendoza, Octopus, Entropia, Muro del Nahuel, El Muro Tucuman, Boulder Club Mar del Plata, Palestra Carlos Paz, Trelew, Pachamama and others) = about 45, with room for undiscovered gyms and some Bouldeer entries that may be mountain clubs without bouldering.

indicative_gap.basis: Independent total 45-65 minus Bouldeer 20 = 25-45; cross-check (1 - 0.38) x 45-65 = 28-40. Quoted gap 25-45. Lower confidence than other countries: no aggregate national figure.

missing_cities: Buenos Aires city neighbourhoods (Parque Chas, Villa Crespo/other CABA sites)
missing_chains: No real chains. Club Andino sites and CABA (Centro Andino Buenos Aires) run several boulder rooms, Bouldeer has only the Rivadavia site; Bucarelli (Parque Chas) is missing
countries.difficulty_reason: Mostly independent small schools, club walls and gyms with Facebook/Instagram as the main presence; no federation gym list or chain pages; Spanish; Bouldeer already contains some mountain clubs and schools whose bouldering offer is unclear, which complicates reconciliation.
countries.notes: Recommended as a staged section (Buenos Aires metro first, then Mendoza, Bariloche and Tucuman). Sample size 16 only, directories only, so confidence is low. Several Bouldeer entries look like mountain clubs or outdoor schools (Club Andino Sosneado, Club Andino Burzaco, Ahonikenk, Bien Alto, Heidrun); their bouldering offer was not checked and not investigated further. Boulder Club (Mar del Plata) and Muro del Nahuel / El Muro Tucuman were confirmed only through directory text or a Facebook page, so treat them as weaker evidence.
